name: Case Diary
report_script:
columns = [
    {"label": "Previous Date", "fieldname": "business_on_date", "fieldtype": "Date"},
    {"label": "Hearing Date", "fieldname": "hearing_date", "fieldtype": "Date"},
    {"label": "Court Number and Judge", "fieldname": "court_number_and_judge"},
    {"label": "ID", "fieldname": "case_id", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Case"},
    {"label": "Case Title", "fieldname": "case_title"},
    {"label": "Case Stage", "fieldname": "case_stage"},
    {"label": "Next Purpose", "fieldname": "purpose_of_hearing"},
    {"label": "Next Hearing Date", "fieldname": "next_hearing_date", "fieldtype": "Date"},
    {"label": "Assigned To", "fieldname": "assigned_to", "fieldtype": "Data"},
]

conditions = []
query_filters = {
    "from_date": filters.get("from_date"),
    "to_date": filters.get("to_date"),
}

if filters.get("service"):
    conditions.append("c.service IN %(service)s")
    query_filters["service"] = tuple(filters.get("service"))

if filters.get("case_stage"):
    conditions.append("c.case_stage IN %(case_stage)s")
    query_filters["case_stage"] = tuple(filters.get("case_stage"))

# Construct the WHERE clause dynamically
where_clause = " AND ".join(conditions)
if where_clause:
    where_clause = " AND " + where_clause  # Append conditions only if they exist

query = f"""
    SELECT
        ch.business_on_date,
        ch.hearing_date,
        c.court_number_and_judge,
        c.name AS case_id,
        CONCAT(c.case_title, "\n", c.registration_number) AS case_title,
        c.case_stage AS case_stage,
        ch.purpose_of_hearing
    FROM
        `tabCase History` ch
        JOIN `tabCase` c ON c.name = ch.parent
    WHERE
        ch.hearing_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
        {where_clause}
"""

result = frappe.db.sql(query, query_filters, as_dict=True)

for record in result:
    next_hearing_date = frappe.db.get_value("Case History", {"business_on_date": record.hearing_date, "parent": record.case_id}, "hearing_date") or ""
    record["next_hearing_date"] = next_hearing_date
    record["assigned_to"] = ''
    
    formatted_hearing_date = frappe.utils.formatdate(record.hearing_date).replace("-","")
    task_subject = f"{record.case_id}-Hearing-{formatted_hearing_date}"
    task = frappe.db.exists("Task", {'subject': task_subject})
    if task:
        assigned_to = frappe.db.get_value("Task", task, '_assign')
        emp = json.loads(assigned_to)[0] if assigned_to else ''
        if emp:
            record["assigned_to"] = frappe.db.get_value("User", emp, "full_name")
        
data = columns, result
